name: kidsmeal
description: kidsmeal's Claude Code plugins: Gantry, Codebase Cartographer, Compass Rose, and ClauDHD. Add this marketplace once and install any of them.

plugins.name: gantry
plugins.description: Gantry: a gated design -> plan -> build -> review pipeline with PreToolUse enforcement hooks (a file-list guard and a commit guard) and two living audit docs. Reads each project's own conventions; works in any stack.

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Codebase Cartographer: documents a codebase (INDEX map, CLAUDE.md "Where things are" block, GLOSSARY, ROADMAP, CONVENTIONS). Also published standalone in the cartographer marketplace.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Compass Rose: the connective layer over Cartographer, ClauDHD, and Gantry - map-grounded design, a roadmap that is the hub, a two-lane triage, and a unified session brief. Declares the other three as dependencies.

plugins.name: claudhd
plugins.description: ClauDHD: a NOW cursor that follows your branch, an idea inbox, a quick-fixes lane, a shipped log, and branch-aware session breadcrumbs. Also published standalone in the claudhd marketplace.
